pr_body:
`executeAndCancelCommittedPublication` uses 30s timeout for publication task, it makes also to use 30s timeout for request task

Fixes #96693
pr_title: Increase timeout for creating a new index

review_comment: I also see several other cases of `executeAndCancelCommittedPublication()` in this test that ultimately use `.get()` with 10 seconds. Would it be reasonable to change them as well?
Also, any hint as to why it takes so long >10 seconds sometimes?

To clarify, I meant if you could search for the usages of `executeAndCancelCommittedPublication` and go through the subsequent .get()s to make them use 30 seconds as well. I saw like around 5 instances.
